title: Bigin module fails with 'Provided account is not compatible'
symptoms: Scenario create fails with ActionMakeAnAPICall or ActionCreateDeal
cause: The Bigin by Zoho app has two generations. Connections of type bigin-by-zoho2 only work with the second-generation modules, which have lowercase names such as makeAnAPICall, createAPipeline, searchContacts and updateAPipeline and must be declared as version 2.
fix: Use the version 2 module names and set version 2 on each module. Copy module ids from a working scenario's blueprint.
affected: Make Bigin by Zoho app, July 2026
